values.note: Showers (Pine Lane and Aspen Lane buildings), flush toilets, seasonal water and the dump station are summer-only; vault toilets and a jug-filling spigot at the ranger station stay open year-round.

values.note: In winter only one non-electric and one electric site stay open for drive-in camping; others are walk-in after snow cover.

note: Wooded state-park campground near the north-east shore of Lake Bemidji; Oak Lane is the lane nearest the beach and boat landing, and the lake is about 0.1-0.3 mile from the sites through the trees. A June 2025 windstorm flattened parts of the park's forest. --Claude
